label: calibration
design: Cohorts of 60 ticks; each successor cohort arrives 30 ticks before its seniors retire (same schedule in every condition; retirement is never delayed for unfinished lessons). Beam search, same credit pool. 'library': earlier cohorts' admitted artifacts visible, no teaching. 'teaching-only': library hidden across cohorts, teaching sessions on (dependency-aware lessons: missing components are taught inside the session at extra cost). 'none': neither. Teaching is also available within a cohort in 'teaching-only', so its cohort-0 trajectory differs from the other two; library and none share a trajectory until the first arrival (checked).
selection_rule: freeze: lowest validation score among admitted or superseded workflows (components excluded); ties by creation tick then id; the frozen record includes the workflow's dependency closure by hash
